items.context: @GoingParabolic (Jason Ai. Williams, 283.493 seguidores), en inglés, sin imagen: "there are only about 883k bitcoin left to mine. ever — the whole planet gets to fight over that while people dump theirs in a red week. idk man, seems bullish". Publicado hace ~9 min: 10 likes, 1 repost, 3 respuestas, 1.265 vistas. Tema halving y emisión (oferta restante de los 21M).
items.suggested_text:
The math checks out: roughly 20.1M of the 21M are already mined, and the remaining ~883k trickle out at ~450 BTC a day, a pace that keeps halving for more than a century. At the next halving the subsidy drops from 3.125 to 1.5625 BTC per block (~225 BTC a day), and only 3.125% of the total supply will still be left to issue.

That's what a red week hides. Issuance is fixed by code and gets cut in half every 210,000 blocks no matter what price does; only demand moves. Every coin dumped in a dip lands with someone else, while the new supply behind that trade keeps shrinking.

And the scarcer number may not be the 883k left to mine, but how many of the already-mined coins will simply never move again.
